newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight market quiet, no business reported.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight market quiet, no business reported.

text.p: Business was very slow on the sugar freight market with only a few of the week's earlier inquiries re-circulating around the shipbroking fraternity, market sources said on Friday.

SIMAB's recent Itajai/Lagos order for bagged sugar was still unfilled, as were the bulk orders issued by Cargill and E D & F Man, for Buenaventura/US Gulf/Atlantic and Puerto Quetzal/Casablanca respectively.
In other news, Libya postponed its tender to buy white sugar until Monday, physical brokers said.
